File Information
Collection: HustleHub+ API - Part 2 (Secure Stack)
Environment: HustleHub+ Local
Collection Description
End-to-end tests for HustleHub+ Part 2: authentication, RBAC, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, admin, validation/sanitisation and rate limiting. Run with Newman from the api folder: npm run test:api The API uses a self-signed certificate, so run Newman with --insecure (already in the npm script) or turn off SSL verification in Postman settings. Requests must run in order: later requests use ids and tokens saved by earlier ones. Each run creates fresh users, so the collection can be run repeatedly. Rate-limit counters are kept in memory; restart the API if you run the collection several times inside 15 minutes.
